description: Create a new flow from an exported flow file (the object neuron_export_flow returns). It is always created switched OFF and never overwrites an existing flow. Inbound webhook URLs get new slugs. The response lists `missing` (steps pointing at a bot, list, session or knowledge base this account doesn't have, which need picking before switching on) and `redacted` (credentials blanked on export that need refilling).

name.description: Name for the new flow. Defaults to the name in the file.

name: neuron_import_flow
title: Import Flow
